title: Events & Environmental Disasters
lede: The environmental catastrophe engine that tests animal adaptability through simulation-wide phenomena and localized crises.

disasters.name: Wildfire
disasters.impact: Consumes forest tiles and deals 20 points of direct fire damage to any organism trapped inside burning cells.
disasters.counterplay: Animals must identify the fire sensory node and execute escape pathing toward open water or plains.

disasters.name: Harsh Winter
disasters.impact: Freezes vegetation nodes and doubles metabolic depletion rate (Hunger x2 multiplier).
disasters.counterplay: Favors organisms with high Endurance and stockpiled energy reserves.

disasters.name: Flash Flood
disasters.impact: Submerges plains adjacent to lake tiles, dealing 15 damage and sweeping unanchored agents 2 tiles eastward.
disasters.counterplay: Requires retreat to elevated forested or mountain-adjacent tiles.

disasters.name: Toxic Chemical Cloud
disasters.impact: Forces an Endurance save check (roll(d10) + END >= 10) on every turn inside the cloud. Failure applies Poison debuff (5 HP damage/turn).
disasters.counterplay: High endurance species or omnivores with Iron Stomach can endure; others must flee.

disasters.name: Earthquake
disasters.impact: Causes 25% injury probability across all agents, reducing movement speed by 50% for 3 turns.
disasters.counterplay: Agility checks reduce injury probability to 10%.

randomEvents.name: Prolonged Drought
randomEvents.effect: Reduces drinkable water tiles by 50% for one weekly cycle, sparking violent clashes around surviving springs.

randomEvents.name: Super Resource Bloom
randomEvents.effect: Doubles flora respawn rate and boosts food nutritional value by 1.5x, enabling aggressive population growth.

randomEvents.name: Seasonal Herbivore Migration
randomEvents.effect: Grants 15 bonus stamina points when agents sustain unidirectional movement across 5 consecutive turns.

triggeredEvents.name: Rockslide Encounter
triggeredEvents.trigger: Traversing within 1 tile of mountain terrain during seismic disturbances.
triggeredEvents.checks: Escape: roll(d10) + AGI >= 14 | Hide: roll(d10) + END >= 12. Failure inflicts 15 blunt damage.

triggeredEvents.name: Curious Object Discovery
triggeredEvents.trigger: Entering a cell containing ancient terrain remnants.
triggeredEvents.checks: Investigate: roll(d10) + INT >= 13. Success awards permanent training points; failure inflicts brief confusion.
